summary: Coordinate data backlogs, quality checks and delivery flow with practical exercises. Explore the five-day agile data management course.
lede: Agile data management helps data stewards, data product owners and delivery leads coordinate incremental data changes through short feedback cycles. The training covers prioritizing data backlogs, clarifying ownership, defining quality acceptance checks, tracking work in progress, reviewing data contracts and preparing release-readiness evidence, making delivery progress and decisions easier to review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate changing data requirements across business teams, data functions and technology delivery. It suits intermediate practitioners who already contribute to data or agile work and need practical ways to organize the work, confirm ownership and make delivery progress visible.
prerequisites: Prior experience working with data requests, data quality, data stewardship or an agile delivery team is expected. Familiarity with basic backlog or workflow concepts will help. No programming is required; exercises use data management artefacts and may use Excel for flow measures.
